title: Minuteman III attacks Kwajalein
summary: Footage of a Minuteman III ICBM test launch and its reentry vehicles striking the Kwajalein atoll target area. It shows the missile climbing through clouds and the warheads descending.
why: Linked as unusually clear real footage of ICBM reentries and impacts whenever missile tests or the Marshall Islands come up.

quote.text: It has some of the clearest footage of the actual reentries and impacts
